label: def:knot-particle-generation
title: Knot-particle generation from $T_{m,n}$ torus knot generators
html:
Definition. The particle spectrum is generated from a finite set of torus knot generators T_{m,n} (with \gcd(m,n) = 1) embedded in the standard torus \mathbb{T}^2 \subset S^3, together with two linking operations that act on the exceptional divisor and the color-tube fibration. The torus knot generators are the family

  \mathcal{G} =  \bigl\{ T_{m,n}  \big| 
  \gcd(m,n) = 1, m < n,
  m + n \leq N(\chi) \bigr\},

where T_{m,n} winds m times around the meridian and n times around the longitude of \mathbb{T}^2, and N(\chi) is a cutoff determined by the Euler characteristic of the Frobenius--Hopf object. For the Descartes universe with \chi(A) = -6, the bound is N(-6) = 9, admitting:

See Table.

We reserve q for the substrate parameter and p for base points. The winding indices are always (m,n).
